entries.name: Early childhood mental health
entries.definition: The social and emotional well-being of children from birth to about age five, and the practice of supporting it and treating problems.

entries.name: Earned value management system
entries.definition: An integrated project-management system that compares work done with planned scope, schedule and cost, as set out in the ANSI/EIA-748 guidelines.

entries.name: Earth leakage circuit breaker
entries.definition: A protective switch that cuts the power when current leaks to earth, to reduce the risk of electric shock and fire.

entries.name: Earthing systems
entries.definition: The ways of connecting parts of an electrical installation to the ground for safety, such as TN, TT and IT systems.

entries.name: EaselJS
entries.definition: A JavaScript library that provides a display list and interaction model for drawing on the HTML5 canvas.

entries.name: eBay API
entries.definition: The programming interfaces of the eBay marketplace, used to list, search and manage items and orders from other software.

entries.name: eClinicalWorks
entries.definition: Software for electronic health records and medical practice management, made by eClinicalWorks.

entries.name: Ecological study
entries.definition: An observational study design in which the units analysed are whole populations or groups rather than individual people.

entries.name: Econometric model
entries.definition: A statistical model that uses economic theory and data to estimate the relationships between economic variables.

entries.name: Eddystone
entries.definition: An open Bluetooth Low Energy beacon format from Google that broadcasts identifiers and URLs.

entries.name: EDIUS
entries.definition: A non-linear video editing application from Grass Valley.

entries.name: Educational assessment
entries.definition: The process of gathering and interpreting evidence about what learners know and can do.

entries.name: Educational therapy
entries.definition: Giving individualised, strategy-based help to learners with learning differences such as dyslexia or ADHD.

entries.name: Eight Disciplines problem solving
entries.definition: A structured team method, developed in the automotive industry, for finding the root cause of a recurring problem, fixing it and preventing it from returning.

entries.name: Einstein Analytics
entries.definition: Salesforce's analytics and business-intelligence platform, later renamed Tableau CRM and then CRM Analytics.

entries.name: Elastic Stack
entries.definition: A set of tools from Elastic, originally Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana, used together to collect, search and visualise log and event data.

entries.name: Electric meters
entries.definition: Instruments that measure the electrical energy used by a home, building or circuit.

entries.name: Electric vehicle
entries.definition: A vehicle driven by one or more electric motors powered by a battery.

entries.name: Electrical diagnostics and repair
entries.definition: Finding the cause of faults in electrical systems and equipment and fixing them.

entries.name: Electrical power quality
entries.definition: How well the supply voltage and current stay within specified limits, including voltage sags, harmonics and interruptions.

entries.name: Electrical wiring
entries.definition: Installing and connecting electrical cables and devices in buildings and equipment.

entries.name: Electromechanical engineering
entries.definition: The branch of engineering that combines electrical and mechanical engineering to design devices such as motors, actuators and robots.

entries.name: Electron microscope
entries.definition: A microscope that images specimens with a beam of electrons, reaching far higher magnification than a light microscope.

entries.name: Electronic article surveillance
entries.definition: Retail anti-theft technology in which tagged items set off an alarm when carried through detectors at an exit.

entries.name: Electronic data capture
entries.definition: Collecting data directly into computer systems instead of on paper, most often in clinical trials using dedicated software.

entries.name: Electronic paper
entries.definition: Display technology that mimics ink on paper, reflecting light and holding an image without power, as used in e-readers.

entries.name: Electronic prescribing
entries.definition: Creating prescriptions on a computer and sending them electronically to a pharmacy.

entries.name: Electronic publishing
entries.definition: Producing and distributing books, journals and other content in digital formats.

entries.name: Electrosurgery
entries.definition: Using high-frequency electric current to cut, coagulate or destroy tissue during surgery.

entries.name: Email etiquette
entries.definition: Writing and replying to email in a clear, courteous and appropriate way for the workplace.

entries.name: Email on Acid
entries.definition: A commercial service for previewing and testing how emails display across email clients and devices.

entries.name: Email service providers
entries.definition: Services that send, deliver and track bulk or transactional email for organisations, such as Mailchimp or SendGrid.

entries.name: Email software
entries.definition: Applications for composing, sending, receiving and organising email.

entries.name: Embalming
entries.definition: Treating a dead body with preservative chemicals to delay decomposition and prepare it for viewing and burial.

entries.name: Ember.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript framework for building ambitious single-page web applications.

entries.name: Embroidery machine operation
entries.definition: Setting up and running machines that stitch designs into fabric.

entries.name: Emergency procedures
entries.definition: The documented steps to follow when an emergency such as a fire, injury or equipment failure occurs.

entries.name: Emergency vehicle operations
entries.definition: Driving ambulances, fire apparatus and police vehicles safely and quickly in emergency response.

entries.name: Emission calculations
entries.definition: Estimating the amount of pollutants or greenhouse gases a source releases, from activity data and emission factors.

entries.name: Employee relations
entries.definition: Managing the relationship between an employer and its workforce, including handling grievances, conduct issues and communication.
